author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven
claim_boundary: Causal-targetability discrimination in the deterministic dense competing-geometry conditions the fixture suite represents. NOT arbitrary Isaac scenes, NOT Hospital resolved, NOT Office or Warehouse revalidated. Those require remeasurement under this contract.
parent_scope: target-specific probe semantics in the sparse deterministic geometry its nine fixtures contained

proven_properties.gate_can_refuse: DENSE_NONISOLATABLE_TARGET stays TARGET_NOT_ISOLATABLE — a gate that always finds a working ray is a search, not an adequacy test
proven_properties.no_observation_leakage: TargetabilityInput carries no hit, collider, identity or distance field; the decision cannot consult the observation it qualifies
proven_properties.not_a_renamed_observation: counterfactual: targetability unchanged while observation changed when the target was disabled
proven_properties.parent_semantics_intact: all nine sparse regressions still pass
proven_properties.same_target_two_interventions: naive NOT_ISOLATABLE, local ISOLATABLE, hit /World/B — only the intervention differs
proven_properties.unrelated_never_accepted: a structurally distinct competitor is never matched as target

triggering_finding: Eight geometrically reachable Hospital blockers produced five hits on structurally distinct objects. Reachability answered 'can I aim at that region'; the question that mattered was 'will this target be what answers'.
